2607.15781.title: AgentFAIR: A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework for FAIRness Evaluation of Geospatial Datasets
2607.15781.paper_summary: Geospatial datasets support applications from urban planning to climate modeling, yet consistent assessment of FAIR compliance is difficult. Existing evaluators use different rubrics and evidence sources and may fail on JavaScript-rendered pages or repository-specific identifiers. For 50 datasets from 10 repositories, the standard deviation of normalized scores across available tools averages 15.0 percentage points and reaches 30.3 for one dataset. Because these outputs are not equivalent measurements, we use them to characterize disagreement and failure modes, not comparative accuracy. We present AgentFAIR, a multi-agent framework combining structured metadata extraction with 13 sub-principle-specific LLM evaluators. Each produces a 0-3 maturity score, cited evidence, and recommendations; a critic checks evidence and consistency and can request targeted re-evaluation. Mean Findability, Accessibility, Interoperability, and Reusability scores are 79.7%, 70.4%, 45.3%, and 72.0%. Rank correlations with four baseline tools range from 0.31 to 0.61; the FAIR-enough comparison is not statistically significant. On a 10-dataset repeated-run subset, sub-principle agreement averages 89% (standard deviation: 3 percentage points), versus 71% without the critic. A preliminary 15-dataset expert study yields Fleiss' kappa of 0.71 and 82% alignment with expert consensus. API cost is approximately USD 0.054 per dataset. These results support auditability and feasibility, while the limited benchmark, incomplete ablations, and single-model-family validation constrain claims about accuracy and generalization.
2607.15781.paper_summary_zh: 地理空間數據集支持從城市規劃到氣候建模的應用，但對 FAIR 合規性的持續評估卻很困難。現有的評估者使用不同的評分標準和證據來源，並可能在 JavaScript 渲染的頁面或特定於存儲庫的標識符上失效。來自 10 個存儲庫的 50 個數據集的標準差在可用工具中的標準化分數平均為 15.0 個百分點，對於一個數據集達到 30.3。因為這些輸出不是等效的測量，我們用它們來表徵不一致和失敗模式，而不是比較準確性。我們提出了 AgentFAIR，一個多代理框架，結合了結構化元數據提取和 13 個子原則特定的 LLM 評估器。每個評估器產生一個 0-3 的成熟度分數、引用的證據和建議；一位評論者檢查證據和一致性，並可以要求針對性的重新評估。可尋找性、可訪問性、互操作性和可重用性的平均分別為 79.7%、70.4%、45.3% 和 72.0%。與四個基準工具的排名相關性範圍從 0.31 到 0.61；FAIR-enough 的比較在統計上不顯著。在 10 個數據集的重複運行子集上，子原則的一致性平均為 89%（標準差：3 個百分點），而沒有評論者時為 71%。一項初步的 15 數據集專家研究產生了 Fleiss' kappa 值為 0.71，與專家共識的對齊度為 82%。API 成本約為每個數據集 0.054 美元。這些結果支持可審計性和可行性，而有限的基準、不完整的消融和單一模型家族的驗證限制了對準確性和泛化的主張。
